description: Generic MCP host config for the unified workspace-aware rmcp authoring adapter.
notes: Run the host with the repository as its working directory, or replace `.` with an absolute workspace root.
The canonical generated contract is `axiograph authoring integration-manifest --workspace <root>`.
The server publishes one read-only `axiograph_authoring_workspace` tool using authoring_workspace_request_v1 and authoring_workspace_report_v1.
Accepted-state writes require a separate AxiStore PromotionPlan workflow.
